newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak shares mixed on low volumes, SAX up 0.32pts.
newsitem.headline: Slovak shares mixed on low volumes, SAX up 0.32pts.

text.p: Slovak shares closed mixed on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Thursday as the 16-share SAX index increased by 0.32 points to 169.70, boosted mainly by gains to oil and gas storage firm Nafta.

Nafta closed up 50 crowns at 1,100, while VSZ closed unchanged at 650, though its averave price was 0.2 percent hiugher, and oil refinery Slovnaft, the most heavily- capitalised issue on the BSE, closed unchanged at 860.
Dealers have said some signs of reviving investors' interest were already seen on the market, but a long-standing lack of liquidity remains preventing the bourse from livelier performance.
Overall volume eased to 370,729 shares from 981,545 shares traded on Wednesday, while turnover fell to 82.74 million crowns, from 1.081 billion.
